title: Merlin's current Sunday band and playing with Billy Poole
summary: He now plays Sundays in Jospin's band, which has backed Bechet, Nicolas and singer Billy Poole.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Did Nicholas play with you or any of those people?
Yes. Later, two or three times, with a different band, the band which I play now every Sunday.

It's the band of Moglis Jospin, which was the trombone of Luther, with Rabanide, Claude Rabanide, and Pierre Atlan at the clarinet, and one man at the piano, Martin Morel. The rhythm section is very changing. I can't say a name because it's never the same. Yes, I see. But we'll try to do the same kind of music. And we had opportunities to play once with Bechet and twice or three times with Nicolas or other people. I remember we played two times with an American Negro singer, Billy Poole, who sings very well in the style of Bessie Smith. We played blues and old songs with him. It was very pleasant to us. How old is she? About seventh grade.
How old? I think about 23. I'm not sure.
